panels.description:
流量使用率：每核分配48M或96MB(<=2core)
包量使用率：每核分配9w或15w(<=2core)
适用于大部分腾讯云cvm

targets.source:
(
    (
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role="redis_master"}[1m]))
      +
      max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", device_name="eth1", instance_role="redis_master"}[1m]))
    ) * 100
  )
  /
  # 2. 计算分母：(去重后的核心数 * 对应基准带宽)
  (
    # 逻辑 A：核心数 <= 2，用 96M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role="redis_master"})) <= 2
    ) * (96 * 1024 * 1024)
    or
    # 逻辑 B：核心数 > 2，用 48M 基准
    (
      count by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (group by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id, device_name) (bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain", instance_role="redis_master"})) > 2
    ) * (48 * 1024 * 1024)
  )

100 * (max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) + max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m]))) / sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) / 150000 and sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) <= 2 or (100 * (max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_recv{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) + max by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (max_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:net:speed_packets_sent{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",device_name="eth1",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m]))) / sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) / 90000 and sum by(ip, bk_target_cloud_id) (count_over_time(bkmonitor:dbm_system:cpu_detail:usage{cluster_domain="$cluster_domain",instance_role="redis_master"}[1m])) > 2)
